svg.title: A rifle attack reaches contact, then separates a stopped cover impact from an unblocked damage path
svg.desc: A production rifleman unit and authoritative trace reach first contact. A blocking-cover branch stops with zero target damage. A separate unblocked branch applies eighty-percent armor retention, twenty damage, then uses production health and status channels for atomic consequences. The depicted bindings are COMBAT-TRACE-002, COMBAT-COLLISION-001, COMBAT-COVER-003, COMBAT-ARMOR-004, COMBAT-DAMAGE-001, COMBAT-HEALTH-001, COMBAT-WOUND-001, COMBAT-SUPPRESSION-001, COMBAT-COLLATERAL-001, and COMBAT-ATTACK-RESOLUTION-001.

g.aria-label: Production four-by-four-cell persistent-renderer unit at one-half documentation scale
g.title: Rifleman source: production four-by-four-cell footprint at half documentation scale, before trace evaluation.
Exact production rifleman glyph primitives, scaled without changing their symbolic meaning.

g.aria-label: Production trace and first-contact overlay primitives at one-half documentation scale
g.title: Authoritative trace reaches first contact, the branch point for blocking cover or an unblocked path.

polyline.title: Trace-to-contact edge: shot tracing reaches first contact before cover or armor resolution.

path.title: Blocking-cover branch: collision resolves against cover and exits with zero target damage.

g.aria-label: Production direction-overlay primitive shows blocking cover at one-half documentation scale
g.title: Blocking-cover outcome: cover consumes the collision, the projectile stops, and target damage is zero.

path.title: Unblocked branch: cover does not consume contact, so armor and damage evaluation continue.

g.aria-label: Production direction-overlay primitive shows armor coverage at one-half documentation scale
g.title: Unblocked contact continues through armor retention 0.8 before damage and consequences are assembled.

path.title: Armor-to-consequence edge: retained damage feeds one atomic result, not partial state updates.

g.aria-label: Production health and separate status overlays at one-half documentation scale plus faction-neutral consequence fields
g.title: Completed consequence: damage 20, health 80 of 100, NoWound, and suppression 12.
